protocol_note: New economic hypothesis, not a campaign of any closed family. Candidates are evaluated through the existing registered economic_walk_forward_v1 protocol; the decision stream is emitted by the real native Rust strategy (mqk backtest native-signals); no trading rule or state is re-implemented in Python. Hypothesis != trial != attempt != evaluation slice: one hypothesis, one trial per fixed symbol, retries are new attempts of the same trial.

hypothesis.name: Daily statistical pullback mean reversion on a fixed five-asset-class ETF list
hypothesis.economic_rationale: For a broad liquid ETF, a completed daily close at least two population standard deviations below its trailing 20-day mean is a short-term pullback displacement that tends to mean-revert. The strategy buys that displacement and exits when the close returns to the trailing mean; otherwise it is flat. Trend families participate in persistence; this family enters after statistical downside displacement and exits on normalization.
primary_references: Jegadeesh (1990), 'Evidence of Predictable Behavior of Security Returns', Journal of Finance 45(3):881-898
Lehmann (1990), 'Fads, Martingales, and Market Efficiency', Quarterly Journal of Economics 105(1):1-28
Bollinger (2002), 'Bollinger on Bollinger Bands' (the 20-period, 2-standard-deviation band convention)
hypothesis.distinct_from_closed_families: intraday_scalper, trend_sma50 (price vs 50-day mean) and dual_sma_50_200_trend (50-day vs 200-day mean) are all trend or intraday-momentum rules; this is a short-horizon mean-reversion rule with a stateful entry/exit. It is not a parameter retry of any of them, and all three stay closed and unmodified.
hypothesis.falsification_condition: A symbol's candidate is REJECTED if it fails any gate listed under rejection_gates. The campaign is rejected as a whole if no candidate clears every gate. No other sigma, lookback, exit, filter or stop is evaluated in this campaign.

native_engine.initial_state: FLAT at the start of a run; owned by the strategy instance and persisted across sequential completed bars of that same instance
native_engine.rule: For the latest completed bar t: S = sum of the latest 20 completed closes (including t), Q = sum of their squares, mean20 = S/20, population variance = (20*Q - S^2)/400 (divisor 20), std20 = sqrt(variance). ENTRY (state FLAT) iff close_t <= mean20 - 2.0*std20, equality included. EXIT (state LONG) iff close_t >= mean20, equality included. Otherwise the state is preserved. Target = +1 share while LONG, else 0. Never short.
native_engine.exact_integer_form: entry iff S - 20*c >= 0 and (S - 20*c)^2 >= 4*(20*Q - S^2) and 20*Q - S^2 > 0; exit iff 20*c >= S. All sums in i128 over integer micros; algebraically identical to the stated rule with exact boundary equality, no floating point.

special_cases.incomplete_latest_bar: no new actionable state; the held state is preserved
special_cases.zero_negative_or_incomplete_close_in_the: fail closed: target FLAT and state FLAT

native_engine.state_recovery: On an instance's first on_bar call the state is derived by replaying the same machine, starting FLAT, over the earlier bars of that call's window, so a restarted Paper run or a fresh dry-run instance is a deterministic function of its window. When the first window holds one bar (every Backtest, emitter, scanner and robustness run) this is a no-op, so Backtest and Research semantics equal the stated rule exactly.

universe.selection_rule: The five asset-class proxies of Faber (2007)'s GTAA list that exist as enabled ETFs in config/instruments/equities.json: US equities, foreign developed equities, 10-year Treasuries, US real estate, commodities. DBC/GSCI is not in the registry; GLD is the registry's commodity proxy.
universe.survivorship_note: A fixed list of long-lived, still-listed ETFs is not point-in-time clean. Each symbol is its own registered trial and the judge deflates over all five, so selection among them is accounted for; residual survivorship of the list itself is a stated limitation.
universe.population_note: Same fixed list as the closed trend campaigns. Their trial attempts (fifteen for trend_sma50, five for dual_sma_50_200_trend) belong to other hypotheses and experiments; they are disclosed, are not part of this campaign's judge population, and are not hidden.

experiment.population_policy: The judge's population is every trial registered under real_experiment_id in this campaign's own registry (scope = experiment_id, hypothesis_id unset); losing and failed trials are never excluded by hand.

fallback_if_corporate_action_gate_refuse.note: Boundary already established as corporate-action-safe by prior campaigns. Used only if the fail-closed gate refuses the primary window; declared now, before any result.

reuse_verified_data_from.rule: byte-identical reuse after verifying the provenance manifest artifact_sha256 and row_count against the CSV; no new provider call

partition.holdout_rule: last 6 calendar months of the dataset, reserved_not_evaluated, never consumed by this campaign
partition.warmup_note: The Rust emitter receives bars from 2016-01-04 and the first 20 completed closes exist in 2016-02; the partition is carried over unchanged, so the first month of fold 1 is structurally flat.

native_backtest.initial_cash_rule: USD 1,000 for every symbol, fixed now; one share of every listed symbol costs less than this over the whole window
native_backtest.bars: the same provenance-bound research bars converted deterministically, truncated at the holdout start

robustness.source_note: Reuses the finite values the Wave06 campaign already froze before its results; the notional cap is half the single-symbol long-only natural position (equity_usd x max_gross_exposure = 100,000).

scanner_review.policy: mqk_backtest::StrategyScanReviewPolicy::default (min_bars 252, min_trades 5, min_return_pct 0, min_alpha_pct 0, max_drawdown_pct 25, min_profit_factor 1.05) -- unchanged
scanner_review.data: the same discovery-only converted bars (truncated at the holdout start), one registry/bars root per campaign run

promotion_policy.note: No canonical production threshold values exist in the deployed configuration. These are fixed now, before any result, and are supplied to the daemon only for the promotion transition.

rejection_gates: economic evaluation fails or is insolvent
judge not evaluable (DSR/PBO) or DSR below promotion_policy minimum or PBO above maximum
any required robustness scenario fails or is not evaluable (canonical P9 gauntlet, genuine shuffled placebo, P7A/P7B stress, DSR/PBO block-count sensitivity)
any promotion_policy threshold fails in canonical evaluate_promotion

stopping_rule.if_no_candidate_clears_every_gate: record REJECTED and stop; any other sigma, lookback, exit, filter or stop needs a new explicit operator decision
stopping_rule.infrastructure_failure: retry the same attempt/trial identity under the existing contract; an economic failure is finalized failed and never retried

attempt_identity_rules: A retry after an infrastructure failure is a new attempt of the SAME trial_id. trial_id derives from strategy_id, symbol, native semantic fingerprint, bars provenance, partition policy and economic protocol only.
forbidden_after_predeclaration: changing the symbol list, lookback, sigma multiplier, partition, costs, sizing, thresholds or review policy after seeing any result
defining identity from a result value
promoting any candidate by hand or outside the production transition route
adding any parameter, stop, filter or confirmation rule

execution_fidelity.metric: fraction of evaluated bars on which the simulated discrete share position (held before that bar's order) agrees, long vs flat, with the executed desired weight; positions only, never P&L
execution_fidelity.enforced_by: mqk_research.ml.native_signal_registry_integration.NATIVE_EXECUTION_FIDELITY_FLOOR; an attempt below the floor is finalized failed and kept

sizing_note: Carried forward unchanged from campaign 03 / the dual-SMA campaign (equity_usd 100000, max_position_notional_usd 50000, stress cap 25000 = half of baseline so P7B stays strictly tighter). It was validated for execution fidelity, not chosen for profitability.
backtest_history_note: The backtest engine window is max(config bar_history_len, the strategy's required_history_bars()); this engine declares 20. Paper loads 256 bars per dispatch, guarded against every registered engine's requirement.

activity_report.rule: measured and reported; no threshold is created from these numbers.

review_and_promotion_freeze: scanner_review policy, promotion_policy thresholds and the P9 robustness scenarios (including month_year_regime_concentration) are carried over byte-for-byte from campaign 03 and the dual-SMA campaign and are not reopened by any observed result.
